summary: The visible suite now passes (3/3). The cause was in `solution/util.py`: `_parse_field` always returned `restricted=False`, so `day_ok` in `solution/core.py` treated both day-of-month and day-of-week as wildcards and never filtered on them. I changed it to return `not field.startswith("*")`, matching Vixie cron, so `*/n` still counts as unrestricted. I also changed `solution/core.py` so that when both day fields are restricted they match with OR instead of AND, which is standard cron behaviour; that second change goes beyond the visible failures, so check it against the hidden suite if it asserts AND. Nothing under `tests/` was touched and the public API is unchanged.
